title: Personality
focus: 性格 · 脾气 · 耐心 · 固执 · 靠谱 · 自私 · 外向 · 内向
body:
# Personality

Words for describing people: temperament, temper, and whether you can count on them. You use them about colleagues, partners and, often, your own parents.

| Chinese | Pinyin | Meaning | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| 性格 | xìnggé | personality / character | pattern of your inborn nature |
| 脾气 | píqi | temper / disposition | spleen energy → temper |
| 耐心 | nàixīn | patience / patient | a heart that can endure |
| 固执 | gùzhí | stubborn | gripping your view rigidly |
| 靠谱 | kàopǔ | reliable / dependable (colloquial, of a person) | sticks to the score → dependable |
| 自私 | zìsī | selfish | only your own private interest |
| 外向 | wàixiàng | outgoing / extroverted | facing outward → outgoing |
| 内向 | nèixiàng | introverted / reserved | facing inward → introverted |

## Which word?

**性格 vs 脾气**: 性格 is your whole personality (外向, 内向); 脾气 is temper, how easily you blow up (脾气好 = easygoing).

**固执 vs 坚持**: 固执 is stubborn (negative); 坚持 is sticking with something (positive).

## Sentences

- 他性格内向，但做事特别靠谱。 tā xìnggé nèixiàng, dàn zuòshì tèbié kàopǔ: He's introverted, but very reliable at work.
- 我爸性格太固执，跟他根本没法沟通。 wǒ bà xìnggé tài gùzhí, gēn tā gēnběn méi fǎ gōutōng: My dad is so stubborn there's no talking to him.
- 她脾气好，又有耐心，难怪学生都喜欢她。 tā píqi hǎo, yòu yǒu nàixīn, nánguài xuésheng dōu xǐhuan tā: She's easygoing and patient. No wonder the students all like her.
- 他最大的缺点就是没耐心。 tā zuì dà de quēdiǎn jiù shì méi nàixīn: His biggest weakness is that he has no patience.
- 他欠钱一直不还，太不靠谱了。 tā qiàn qián yìzhí bù huán, tài bú kàopǔ le: He owes money and never pays it back. So unreliable.
- 他太自私了，从来不体谅别人。 tā tài zìsī le, cónglái bù tǐliàng biérén: He's so selfish. He never considers how anyone else feels.
- 他看起来外向，其实挺内向的。 tā kàn qǐlai wàixiàng, qíshí tǐng nèixiàng de: He seems outgoing, but he's actually quite introverted.
- 说实话，Ollie脾气比我还大。 shuō shíhuà, Ollie píqi bǐ wǒ hái dà: Honestly, Ollie has a worse temper than I do.

cards.Example: 他们俩性格不合，老吵架。 tāmen liǎ xìnggé bù hé, lǎo chǎojià: Their personalities clash and they're always arguing
cards.Notes: 性 xìng nature, 忄 heart + 生 born (个性, 性别) + 格 gé grid, pattern (格子, 风格, 表格) = the pattern of your inborn nature. 性格 = overall temperament; 个性 = individuality, what makes someone distinctive

cards.Example: 他脾气不好，动不动就发火。 tā píqi bù hǎo, dòngbudòng jiù fāhuǒ: He has a bad temper and blows up at the slightest thing
cards.Notes: 脾 pí spleen, 月 body part + 气 qì air, energy (生气, 天气) = spleen energy: Chinese medicine tied moods to the organs' 气. 发脾气 = to lose your temper; 脾气好 = easygoing

cards.Example: 教小孩一定要有耐心。 jiāo xiǎohái yídìng yào yǒu nàixīn: You have to be patient teaching kids
cards.Notes: 耐 nài endure (耐用 durable, 忍耐) + 心 xīn heart = a heart that can endure. Opposite: 不耐烦 = impatient. 有耐心 / 没耐心; also an adjective: 他很耐心

cards.Example: 我爸特别固执，谁的话都不听。 wǒ bà tèbié gùzhí, shéi de huà dōu bù tīng: My dad is really stubborn and won't listen to anyone
cards.Notes: 固 gù solid, firm (坚固, 固定) + 执 zhí grip, 扌 hand (执照, 执行) = gripping your view rigidly. Negative; 坚持 = 坚 firm + 持 hold, positive persistence. Spoken 倔 (juè) is also common

cards.Example: 这个人做事很靠谱，你放心吧。 zhège rén zuòshì hěn kàopǔ, nǐ fàngxīn ba: This guy is reliable, don't worry
cards.Notes: 靠 kào lean on (依靠, 靠近) + 谱 pǔ musical score, pattern (乐谱, 菜谱) = sticks close to the score, in tune, so you can count on them. Opposite 离谱 = way off the score, outrageous. Colloquial; 不靠谱 = flaky. The formal word is 可靠

cards.Example: 只考虑自己，太自私了。 zhǐ kǎolǜ zìjǐ, tài zìsī le: Only thinking about yourself is really selfish
cards.Notes: 自 zì self (自己) + 私 sī private (私人, 隐私) = only your own private interest. Mirror: 无私 = selfless; 公 public vs 私 private (公私分明)

cards.Example: 她性格外向，跟谁都聊得来。 tā xìnggé wàixiàng, gēn shéi dōu liáo de lái: She's outgoing and gets along with everyone
cards.Notes: 外 wài outside (外面, 外国) + 向 xiàng facing (方向) = facing outward. Mirror: 内向 = facing inward. Usually said of 性格: 性格外向

cards.Example: 我比较内向，不太喜欢参加聚会。 wǒ bǐjiào nèixiàng, bú tài xǐhuan cānjiā jùhuì: I'm fairly introverted and don't really like parties
cards.Notes: 内 nèi inside (内部) + 向 xiàng facing (方向) = facing inward. Mirror: 外向 = facing outward. Usually said of 性格: 性格内向

cards.English: He's introverted, but very reliable at work.
cards.Hanzi: 他性格内向，但做事特别靠谱。
cards.Pinyin: tā xìnggé nèixiàng, dàn zuòshì tèbié kàopǔ.
cards.Notes: 性格 (L12) + 内向 (L12) + 靠谱 (L12). 做事 = how someone gets things done.

cards.English: My dad is so stubborn there's no talking to him.
cards.Hanzi: 我爸性格太固执，跟他根本没法沟通。
cards.Pinyin: wǒ bà xìnggé tài gùzhí, gēn tā gēnběn méi fǎ gōutōng.
cards.Notes: 性格 (L12) + 固执 (L12) + 沟通 (L8). 根本没法 = there's just no way to.

cards.English: She's easygoing and patient. No wonder the students all like her.
cards.Hanzi: 她脾气好，又有耐心，难怪学生都喜欢她。
cards.Pinyin: tā píqi hǎo, yòu yǒu nàixīn, nánguài xuésheng dōu xǐhuan tā.
cards.Notes: 脾气 (L12) + 耐心 (L12) + 难怪 (L7). 脾气好 = good-tempered, easygoing.

cards.English: His biggest weakness is that he has no patience.
cards.Hanzi: 他最大的缺点就是没耐心。
cards.Pinyin: tā zuì dà de quēdiǎn jiù shì méi nàixīn.
cards.Notes: 耐心 (L12) + 缺点 (L11). 没耐心 = impatient (also 不耐烦).

cards.English: He owes money and never pays it back. So unreliable.
cards.Hanzi: 他欠钱一直不还，太不靠谱了。
cards.Pinyin: tā qiàn qián yìzhí bù huán, tài bú kàopǔ le.
cards.Notes: 靠谱 (L12) + 欠 (L9). 不靠谱 = flaky; 离谱 = outrageous.

cards.English: He's so selfish. He never considers how anyone else feels.
cards.Hanzi: 他太自私了，从来不体谅别人。
cards.Pinyin: tā tài zìsī le, cónglái bù tǐliàng biérén.
cards.Notes: 自私 (L12) + 体谅 (L8). 从来不 = never (as a habit).

cards.English: He seems outgoing, but he's actually quite introverted.
cards.Hanzi: 他看起来外向，其实挺内向的。
cards.Pinyin: tā kàn qǐlai wàixiàng, qíshí tǐng nèixiàng de.
cards.Notes: 外向 (L12) + 内向 (L12). 看起来…，其实… = looks like ..., but really ...

cards.English: Honestly, Ollie has a worse temper than I do.
cards.Pinyin: shuō shíhuà, Ollie píqi bǐ wǒ hái dà.
cards.Notes: 脾气 (L12) + 说实话 (L1). 脾气大 = hot-tempered.
